milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the spruce log column and face it to demonstrate they have found it. Target is the center of the spruce log column at spawn-relative (6, 1, 6). max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 ensure the player can see the logs from a reasonable distance while facing them.

Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce_wood block drops the spruce_wood item into the player's inventory. The player must break at least 1 of the 3 spruce_wood blocks (at ~4, 0-2, 8) using their wooden axe. Checking inventory is the most direct and reliable way to confirm the block was mined.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the spruce planks structure and face it. Target is the center of the planks structure at spawn-relative (10, 0, 6). max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 ensure the player is looking toward the planks, confirming visual discovery.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a door with spruce planks produces a 'spruce_door' item that appears in the player's inventory. The player must mine 6 spruce_planks blocks, then use the crafting table at (~8, 0, 10) to arrange them in a 2x3 pattern. CommonSenseAgent confirmed that spruce planks specifically yield 'spruce_door', not generic 'door'.
